3DCarousel.description: A full-frame carousel rotates editorial image cards through depth.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in fashion, culture, travel, or visual-essay edits
A frame-dominant transition that can replace its cards with non-face image details
avoid_when: The video needs literal documentary continuity or restrained business graphics
The carousel imagery depends on protected readable faces or dense on-screen copy
3DCarousel.style_rationale: The reviewed sequence moves image cards through a deep curved carousel, making a spatial editorial handoff rather than a compact overlay.

3DStackMotion.description: A futuristic full-frame poster/card grid gives way to a centered SYNTHETICA SAPIENS title on dark purple before ending in a near-empty dark state.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial in technology, music, sci-fi, and design-forward videos
A fullscreen title handoff that can move from a graphic card grid into one short centered phrase
avoid_when: The video needs literal continuous footage, a sober documentary tone, or a naturalistic environment
The visual system cannot support a dense poster/card opening followed by a dark title hold
3DStackMotion.style_rationale: The reviewed start is a dense futuristic poster/card grid, the middle isolates SYNTHETICA SAPIENS on dark purple, and the end leaves a near-empty dark screen; this is a title-led full-frame handoff, not an isolated-plane animation.

ColumnScroll.description: Tall editorial images and serif type travel in alternating columns.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial for fashion, architecture, travel, and art-direction videos
A fullscreen editorial sequence built from vertical image crops and short titles
avoid_when: The subject requires stable readable captions over the same frame
The footage is informal, literal, or has no compatible image material
ColumnScroll.style_rationale: The visible alternating image columns and large serif treatment read as a scrolling magazine spread that can carry a section beat.

ConnectedGrid.description: A connected image grid reconfigures panels and crops across the screen.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in design reels, portfolio stories, and visual lists
A fullscreen transition using compatible objects, scenes, textures, or non-face crops
avoid_when: The cue needs a single calm focal point or long readable copy
The underlying footage already contains dense framing or protected faces
ConnectedGrid.style_rationale: The reviewed default fills the frame with linked image panels whose crop and arrangement change as one designed grid.

CoverPageTransition.description: A bold cover image expands into a full editorial page.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial in fashion, editorial, and culture videos
A fullscreen reveal that introduces one title and one replaceable hero image
avoid_when: The cue requires a quiet documentary cut or several competing messages
The selected image contains a protected face that would be enlarged or cropped
CoverPageTransition.style_rationale: The reviewed red cover state opens into a magazine-like hero composition, a clear page-scale reveal rather than a sticker.

DecorativeLetterAnimations.description: Oversized decorative letters cycle through expressive display treatments.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial for music, design, youth-culture, and experimental edits
A fullscreen title beat with a short adaptable phrase
avoid_when: The narration needs dense factual text or a sober corporate tone
The cue must preserve readable footage continuously behind the title
DecorativeLetterAnimations.style_rationale: Large changing letterforms visibly own the frame and create an energetic sequence of title-reveal states.

FullscreenClipEffect.description: An image is revealed through repeated rounded clip shapes across a color field.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in playful design, travel, food, or product storytelling
A fullscreen image reveal using one object, scene, or texture
avoid_when: The production needs restrained realism or long-form explanatory continuity
The crop must retain a protected face or several small details
FullscreenClipEffect.style_rationale: The visible frame is constructed from repeated clipped apertures that reveal imagery as a deliberate graphic transition.

FullscreenScroll.description: A dark fullscreen slideshow scrolls image and text pairs through a cinematic field.
best_for: A chapter, interstitial, or outro for cinematic essays, trailers, and mood-led travel stories
A fullscreen sequence where image and a short title can replace the demo content
avoid_when: The edit is upbeat, data-heavy, or requires many simultaneous labels
The footage must remain visible as literal continuity behind the graphics
FullscreenScroll.style_rationale: The reviewed dark frame uses a large image-and-title pair moving through a full-screen slideshow, which reads as a cinematic section pause.

GridToSlider.description: A graphic image grid resolves into a centered slider composition.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in fashion, music, art, and product-launch edits
A fullscreen pivot between a gallery grid and one selected image
avoid_when: The audience needs immediate plain-language explanation
The scene cannot tolerate dense graphic panels or image cropping
GridToSlider.style_rationale: The reviewed black composition combines a large wordmark, portrait cards, and panel changes, giving a dense editorial transition.

ImageExpansionTypography.description: An image expands inside oversized typography and editorial copy.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial for fashion, beauty, culture, and cinematic commentary
A fullscreen title treatment that can use an object, landscape, or non-face image inside the type
avoid_when: The title must remain small, utilitarian, or highly detailed
The selected image loses essential information when masked by letters
ImageExpansionTypography.style_rationale: The visible title is inseparable from its imagery: large words and a framed image form a refined editorial reveal.

ImageToGridTransition.description: A hero image breaks into an editorial grid of image fragments.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial for fashion films, visual essays, portfolios, and product stories
A fullscreen handoff from one hero visual to a grid of related image crops
avoid_when: The material has only one image or needs unbroken face readability
The cue needs calm sparse composition or literal continuity
ImageToGridTransition.style_rationale: The contact-sheet image resolves from a dominant portrait into many small gallery tiles, which is inherently a full-frame editorial transition.

IntroGridMotionTransition.description: A lush image grid uses motion and depth to introduce a new visual world.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial in travel, nature, design, and visual-essay videos
A fullscreen introduction built from a coherent set of scenery or object images
avoid_when: The cue needs restrained corporate styling or only a plain title
The images are unrelated, face-dependent, or too detailed at grid scale
IntroGridMotionTransition.style_rationale: The reviewed frame is an immersive field of images with clear depth and motion, a strong entry into a visual chapter.

KineticImages.description: A deterministic Three.js image choreography maps replaceable imagery onto cylinders, a folded paper ribbon, or a spiral surface for cinematic full-frame editorial beats.
best_for: An opener or chapter break in stylized film commentary, director or cinematography analysis, film lists, fashion edits, science-fiction or suspense pieces, and visual essays
A frame-dominant cutaway built from scenes, props, environments, silhouettes, or poster details rather than key readable faces
A focused adaptation that selects one scene mode: cylinders for energetic openings or montages, paper for chapters or reflective endings, and spiral for abstract transitions or outros
avoid_when: The video is documentary, news, corporate, or otherwise depends on literal restrained continuity
The replacement images depend on readable faces, or the underlying shot is already dense
The full animated path would intersect a protected face or head, subtitles, captions, or other required text
The production cue would run the complete three-mode showcase instead of selecting one mode
KineticImages.style_rationale: The dimensional image surfaces read as authored cinematic montage rather than a neutral transition. They are strongest as a full-frame opening or section beat, can resolve into an ending, and are too visually dominant for a small overlay.

KineticTypePageTransition.description: Massive kinetic letterforms reshape a page-scale typographic transition.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial for music, design, film-analysis, and youth-culture pieces
A fullscreen title transition built around a concise high-impact phrase
avoid_when: The cue requires calm narration, detailed copy, or sober institutional tone
The title must share the frame with visible speaker footage
KineticTypePageTransition.style_rationale: The reviewed orange page is dominated by giant moving letterforms, making the type itself the transition event.

LayerMotionSlideshow.description: Layered images and type slide through a refined editorial slideshow.
best_for: A chapter, interstitial, or outro in fashion, travel, photography, and art films
A fullscreen sequence with a short title, one hero image, and controlled layer movement
avoid_when: The footage needs continuous direct-to-camera presence
The visual material is too busy for overlapping images and text
LayerMotionSlideshow.style_rationale: The viewed composition layers a portrait, title, and supporting text in a paced magazine-like slide change.

LayersAnimation.description: Graphic landscape layers parallax through surreal color-blocked scenes.
best_for: An opener, chapter, interstitial, or outro for speculative essays, design films, and atmospheric storytelling
A fullscreen scene transition using simplified landscapes, objects, or silhouettes
avoid_when: The production is literal news, documentary, or corporate communications
The cue needs detailed factual imagery or a visible protected face
LayersAnimation.style_rationale: The contact sheet shows spacious color-blocked worlds with a lone figure and depth layers, suited to a full-frame atmospheric beat.

LinesToLayout.description: Fine lines resolve into a spare editorial image-and-type layout.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in architecture, luxury, design, and reflective essay videos
A fullscreen quiet build from lines into one image and a small amount of copy
avoid_when: The cue needs high energy, fast pacing, or loud visual effects
The source material cannot be reduced to a calm single-image layout
LinesToLayout.style_rationale: The reviewed pale editorial page uses discreet lines and an image panel to form a measured, highly legible section composition.

OneElementScroll.description: One image-led element carries the viewer through a continuous scroll transformation.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in art, product, fashion, and visual-essay edits
A fullscreen transition that can commit to one strong image or object
avoid_when: The cue needs several topics, labels, or competing visuals
The video style is busy, literal, or requires uninterrupted camera footage
OneElementScroll.style_rationale: The reviewed page gives one image-led object most of the space, so the transformation reads as a focused full-screen visual pivot.

OnScrollColumnsRows.description: A sparse white web-page state leaves only small link-like text and a nearly empty field across the reviewed default sequence.
best_for: A quiet interstitial in reflective essays, minimalist design films, and deliberately restrained editorial sequences
A fullscreen pause when one tiny navigational or link-like phrase is enough
avoid_when: The video needs image-led storytelling, expressive color, or immediate emotional impact
The cue must carry a clear title, substantial copy, or a strong visual chapter marker
OnScrollColumnsRows.style_rationale: In the current reviewed default, the supposed columns and image areas do not read as a working image layout: the visible result is a near-empty white page with small link-like text, so this record only supports a minimal pause.

OnScrollFilter.description: A portrait and title are transformed by a strong on-scroll filter treatment.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in fashion, music, beauty, and graphic visual essays
A fullscreen portrait or object treatment when the selected image is not a protected face
avoid_when: The story depends on naturalistic color or readable facial identity
The motion would distort a speaker, interviewee, or documentary evidence
OnScrollFilter.style_rationale: The reviewed warm portrait, title, and aggressive image filter make the composition a stylized editorial reveal rather than neutral footage treatment.

OnScrollLayoutFormations.description: A muted neutral full-frame panel with a tiny label switches to sparse black fullscreen copy and then holds that text state.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in reflective essays, design commentary, and quiet editorial storytelling
A fullscreen shift from a restrained label to one short block of high-contrast copy
avoid_when: The video needs image-led spectacle, dense information, or rapid emotional pacing
The cue must preserve ongoing footage or support several simultaneous messages
OnScrollLayoutFormations.style_rationale: The reviewed start is a muted neutral panel with a tiny label; the middle and end are sparse black fullscreen copy that holds. Its usable mechanism is a minimal text-state transition, not an image-and-layout formation.

OnScrollLetterAnimations.description: Individual letters and image tiles shift through elegant editorial title states.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial in fashion, culture, books, and design content
A fullscreen title sequence that pairs a concise phrase with an image tile
avoid_when: The title needs a plain functional lower third or dense subtitle copy
The selected image must keep a protected face fully visible
OnScrollLetterAnimations.style_rationale: The reviewed states feature centered letterforms and a small image card, creating a polished page-scale editorial title motion.

OnScrollTypographyAnimations.description: Bold full-screen type animates across graphic color fields.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial for music, technology, youth-culture, and energetic explainers
A fullscreen message with a few large readable words
avoid_when: The production requires quiet luxury, documentary naturalism, or long text
The title would collide with required captions or visible footage
OnScrollTypographyAnimations.style_rationale: The purple reviewed frame is a complete color-and-type environment, with kinetic lettering providing the primary visual rhythm.

PixelTransition.description: Pixel-like fragments and screen panels produce a graphic page transition.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in technology, gaming, digital culture, and graphic product videos
A fullscreen image transition where pixel fragmentation supports the story tone
avoid_when: The story requires organic, natural, or understated visual language
The image contains fine readable detail or a protected face that fragmentation would obscure
PixelTransition.style_rationale: The visible versions use a full-screen image surface with digital pixel and panel changes, directly supporting a graphic handoff.

PreviewContentTransition.description: A clean preview card opens into a large editorial content page.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in documentary essays, editorial videos, and product stories
A fullscreen transition from a short teaser phrase to one controlled content statement
avoid_when: The cue needs high-energy spectacle or imagery as the dominant element
The program already has dense text or captions occupying the screen
PreviewContentTransition.style_rationale: The reviewed pale page grows from a preview state into a readable editorial content layout, clearly designed for a section handoff.

RepeatingImageTransition.description: Repeated image echoes create an editorial before-and-after visual transition.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in fashion, music, beauty, and photography-led edits
A fullscreen transition that repeats one compatible object or non-face portrait image
avoid_when: The visual subject must stay literal, stable, and unduplicated
The repeated crops would create confusion around protected faces or evidence imagery
RepeatingImageTransition.style_rationale: The reviewed red portrait state makes duplication and echoing of a central image the transition mechanism, demanding full-frame attention.

RotatingOnScrollAnimations.description: Floating image cards rotate through a dark three-dimensional editorial field.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in fashion, music, cinematic lists, and art-direction reels
A frame-dominant montage of product, landscape, silhouette, or non-face image details
avoid_when: The replacement imagery depends on readable faces or a calm literal-continuity treatment
The cue needs sparse quiet framing or long readable text instead of moving rotating cards
RotatingOnScrollAnimations.style_rationale: The reviewed default moves sparse image cards through depth on black, making an immersive editorial rotation sequence.

Scroll3DGrid.description: A sparse black title state briefly admits a small perspective image-card cluster from a corner before resolving to a near-empty link-like end state.
best_for: A brief interstitial or chapter handoff in technology, sci-fi, gaming, and minimalist visual essays
A fullscreen transition that can move from one short dark title into a small corner-based image detail
avoid_when: The cue needs sustained full-screen spectacle, a dense montage, or a stable hero image
The video requires long readable copy, prominent captions, or literal continuous footage
Scroll3DGrid.style_rationale: The reviewed start is a sparse black title state, the middle contains only a small perspective image-card cluster entering from a corner, and the end is near-empty with link-like fallback text; it is a brief sparse handoff, not a dense 3D card field.

ScrollBasedLayoutAnimations.description: A row of repeated portraits and color panels shifts across a wide editorial layout.
best_for: A chapter, interstitial, or background treatment in fashion, beauty, and creative-portfolio edits
A fullscreen layout built from one coherent image series rather than speaker footage
avoid_when: The repeated subject is a protected person or documentary evidence
The cue needs a sparse neutral background or restrained corporate style
ScrollBasedLayoutAnimations.style_rationale: The visible default uses repeated portrait slices across a wide colored layout, creating a dense editorial sequence with continuous lateral movement.

ScrollBlurTypography.description: A near-black typographic reveal resolves from blur with exceptional restraint.
best_for: A chapter, interstitial, or outro in reflective essays, luxury design films, and quiet cinematic pieces
A fullscreen reveal for one short phrase over a dark field
avoid_when: The cue needs immediate high-contrast factual communication
The title must coexist with visible footage, captions, or numerous graphics
ScrollBlurTypography.style_rationale: The reviewed start, middle, and end remain exceptionally sparse and dark, with blur-to-legibility providing a quiet text-only resolve.

ScrollSpiral.description: A WebGL spiral warps full-frame image texture into an abstract vortex.
best_for: An interstitial, chapter, or outro in sci-fi, music, experimental, and abstract visual-essay edits
A fullscreen texture transition using graphics, environments, or non-identifying image detail
avoid_when: The cue needs literal narration support, readable faces, or sober business context
The source image must remain geometrically faithful and legible
ScrollSpiral.style_rationale: The reviewed variants show an image-driven vortex in several treatments, visibly transforming the whole frame rather than decorating footage.

ShapesSlideshow.description: Large geometric masks reveal cinematic image-and-title slides.
best_for: An opener, chapter, interstitial, or outro for cinematic essays, trailers, travel, and narrative visual pieces
A fullscreen image-and-title beat that uses a simple shape to protect one focal area
avoid_when: The edit needs factual on-screen detail or a light playful tone
The image crop loses essential faces or story evidence behind the mask
ShapesSlideshow.style_rationale: The visible image scenes are revealed by a large circle or shape mask with concise type, a cinematic full-screen section device.

SlideshowAnimations.description: Sculptural objects transform through polished cinematic slideshow states.
best_for: An opener, chapter, interstitial, or outro for design, architecture, product, and art-film content
A fullscreen visual beat built from a single styled object or product silhouette
avoid_when: The cue requires people, documentary realism, or high information density
The production cannot supply an object or graphic material with the same art-directed tone
SlideshowAnimations.style_rationale: The reviewed frames present isolated rocks and sculptural forms under controlled lighting, producing a slow art-film sequence with strong settle poses.

Staggered3DGridAnimations.description: A column of small image tiles staggers through depth against a dark field.
best_for: A chapter or interstitial in technology, fashion, music, and visual-essay videos
A frame-dominant montage of related images, posters, objects, or environments
avoid_when: The viewer needs one stable hero image or long readable title
The grid would repeat protected faces or conflict with a literal documentary scene
Staggered3DGridAnimations.style_rationale: The reviewed default concentrates many small images into a staggered vertical spatial grid, a dense and unmistakably frame-dominant montage.

TextBlockTransitions.description: Large text blocks progress through clean editorial page transitions.
best_for: A chapter, interstitial, or outro in literary essays, documentaries, educational videos, and editorial storytelling
A fullscreen statement using one short edited block of readable copy
avoid_when: The cue needs rapid spectacle, small-screen dense reading, or image-led emotion
The message cannot be reduced to a concise paragraph or sentence
TextBlockTransitions.style_rationale: The reviewed white-page states are built from large readable text blocks and generous margins, matching an article-like section transition.

TypeShuffleAnimation.description: Glitch-like letter shuffling resolves a dark technical title card.
best_for: An opener, chapter, or interstitial for technology, AI, cyber, gaming, and sci-fi explainers
A fullscreen title beat with a short technical phrase and dark graphic backdrop
avoid_when: The production is warm, organic, documentary, or formally conservative
The text must be read before the shuffle settles or compete with captions
TypeShuffleAnimation.style_rationale: The reviewed black frame pairs scrambled small glyphs with technical line art, giving a controlled futuristic title-reveal rhythm.

UnrevealEffects.description: Large serif words and image panels are concealed or uncovered through elegant effects.
best_for: A chapter, interstitial, or outro for fashion, beauty, romance, and cinematic editorial pieces
A fullscreen transition that reveals or conceals one title and one art-directed image panel
avoid_when: The cue needs blunt utilitarian messaging, rapid data, or naturalistic continuity
The selected image needs full face readability or conflicts with subtitles
UnrevealEffects.style_rationale: The reviewed olive and rust pages use large serif words with a central image panel, creating a refined reveal/unreveal section ending.
